summary: PowerBank Corporation filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing it was awarded a contract by the New York Power Authority to develop and construct a 1.628 MW ground-mount solar project at SUNY Oneonta. The estimated construction value is $3.58 million USD, with expected federal investment tax credits of approximately $1.4 million. This is a routine business development announcement, not a special situation. The filing contains no M&A, capital markets, or governance event. No special-situation category applies.
